subject: Television & Streaming
title: Phoebe Waller-Bridge and the Fourth Wall
description: Learn Phoebe Waller-Bridge and the Fourth Wall in one minute.

hook.text: Fleabag looked directly at the camera and talked to the audience. It was intimate, unsettling, and completely addictive.

buildup.text: Phoebe Waller-Bridge wrote, created, and starred in the show. She adapted it from a one-woman stage performance.

discovery.text: The fourth-wall breaks weren't just a gimmick. They revealed how the character performed happiness to hide her grief.

twist.text: Season two introduced a love interest who noticed her looking at the camera. He saw through her performance.

climax.text: Fleabag won six Emmys and ended after two perfect seasons. Waller-Bridge refused to make a third. The story was done.

punchline.text: She stopped while it was perfect. Almost nobody does that.

quiz.question: What storytelling device defined Fleabag?
options: Breaking the fourth wall by speaking directly to the audience
